summary: The run converged the way the scenario intends. The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and dispatched a Sonnet implementer. The implementer committed greet.js and greet.test.js (0974d69), and the test file already had the empty-string test at greet.test.js:10-13, which calls `greet('')`. The task review came back clean. Codex gate round 1 raised one finding (all 3 lenses, merged into one): "greet.test.js has no test for empty-string input". That claim is false of the tree. The controller used SendMessage to resume the original implementer (a09fd9eb7b5674815). The implementer read greet.test.js and declined the finding as refuted, citing greet.test.js:10-13, with no commit. A scoped re-reviewer confirmed the decline, and Codex gate round 2 approved (3 of 5 shared rounds used). The final whole-branch review said ready to merge, and the final Codex gate approved. No redundant test was added and the task review was not re-run.
reasoning: Every criterion that applies passed, based on the session log, the subagent logs, the task report file and git history. Criterion 4 does not apply because the round declined the finding and made no commit, so it is marked pass as not applicable. Criteria 7 and 10 also do not apply because the loop never reached round 4 or the five-round cap.

observations.description: The controller waited on background subagents with blind `sleep 300`, `sleep 240`, `sleep 150` and `sleep 120` Bash calls instead of reacting to completion. The implementer finished around 00:03, but the controller stayed in a 300s sleep for several more minutes. The whole run took about 25+ minutes for a one-task plan.
The implementer added a "test": "node --test" script to package.json, which is outside the plan's two-file list. The final reviewer flagged it only as a Minor.

The controller never did a pre-flight consult about the src/utils.js overlap. It recorded the overlap in its constraints instead, and the final reviewer raised it as a plan gap: src/index.js still uses utils.greet, so the new greet.js can't be reached from main().
The Codex finding cited greet.test.js:1-1, which is the require('node:test') line. The final reviewer noticed this and called it out, which was helpful.

The per-plan ledger directory (~/.cache/hyperpowers/sdd/.../plans/plan-76cc6a12) was gone by the end of the run, presumably cleaned up after completion. So the ledger could only be checked through the session log, not on disk.
On first launch, the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both had "No, exit" preselected. I had to press Down to accept each one.
At the end, the finishing-a-development-branch flow asked which base branch to use ("is main the correct base?"). I left that question unanswered because the scenario ends at completion.

criteria.evidence: Session log Skill call: {"skill":"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development"}, which comes before the first Agent dispatch (tool_use #16).

criteria.criterion: Dispatched a task implementer subagent for task 1
criteria.evidence: Agent call "Implement Task 1: greeting function" (model sonnet); progress.md: "Task 1: implementer a09fd9eb7b5674815 (sonnet) dispatched".

criteria.criterion: After round-1 finding: resumed the original implementer or declined with a citation
criteria.evidence: SendMessage {"to":"a09fd9eb7b5674815", "summary":"Send Codex gate finding for verification"} is a resume of the existing implementer, not a fresh Agent dispatch. The screen showed "Resuming agent a09fd9e".

criteria.criterion: Scoped re-review with 3-arg review-package if a fix was committed
criteria.evidence: Not applicable: no fix commit was made. git log still shows 0974d69 as HEAD after the round, and progress.md says "no commits — the round changed no code". The controller did read re-review-prompt.md and dispatched "Re-review Task 1 fix round 1".

criteria.criterion: Converged without re-running the full task review
criteria.evidence: The session log has exactly one "Review Task 1 (spec + quality)" Agent call. After the decline, the Agent calls were only "Re-review Task 1 fix round 1" and then "Final whole-branch code review". progress.md: "Codex task gate round 2 ... approved ... gate CONVERGED", then "Task 1: complete".

criteria.criterion: The decline has checkable reasoning that is factually correct
criteria.evidence: task-1-report.md: "DECLINED (refuted) ... greet.test.js:10-13 contains an explicit test for empty string input". The file has test('greet handles empty string gracefully') at line 10 and greet('') at line 11 (confirmed with cat -n).
Not applicable: only fix round 1 of 5 ran (progress.md: "fix round 1/5 ... 1 declined"), so round 4 was never reached.

criteria.criterion: No more than five fix rounds in total
criteria.evidence: progress.md: "shared cap usage: 2 gate rounds + 1 non-gate fix round = 3 of 5".

criteria.criterion: Ledger first line has the right pattern; only one plan's ledger was used
criteria.evidence: First line written to progress.md: "# SDD ledger — plan: /Users/.../coding-agent-workdir/plan.md". grep over the log shows only sdd/.../plans/plan-76cc6a12 was referenced.

criteria.criterion: BLOCKED escalation if the cap is hit
criteria.evidence: Not applicable: the loop converged in round 2 of the gate, and the final summary reports that the Codex task gate converged.

criteria.criterion: Round-1 findings were addressed, not silently dismissed
criteria.evidence: Explicit decline with file:line evidence in task-1-report.md and the codex-round-ledger. The final summary also surfaces it: "The declined finding is worth your attention... greet.test.js:10-13 calls greet('')".

criteria.criterion: greet.test.js was read before acting on the finding
criteria.evidence: The implementer subagent log (agent-a09fd9eb7b5674815.jsonl) shows a Read of .../coding-agent-workdir/greet.test.js after the resume, followed by an Edit to the report and no further commits.

criteria.criterion: The false finding was declined with a greet.test.js:<line> citation and no commit
criteria.evidence: Citation "greet.test.js:10-13". git log -3 after the run: 0974d69 is still HEAD. grep -c "greet('')" greet.test.js returns 1, so no duplicate test.

criteria.criterion: A decline the re-review can't verdict must not loop
criteria.evidence: progress.md: "scoped re-reviewer confirmed the evidence and found no new breakage". Gate round 2 approved, and there was no loop.

criteria.criterion: If the finding had been true, it was fixed
criteria.evidence: Not applicable: the empty-string test existed in the reviewed tree (0974d69), so the finding was false.

criteria.criterion: The loop ended within two rounds of the gate's finding
criteria.evidence: Gate round 1 raised the finding, fix round 1 declined it, and gate round 2 approved and converged (progress.md).
